dct_title_s: Geographic Gridlines (Digital Map Database of China)
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This coverage contains longitude and latitude grids. China is located east of Greenwich Mean longitude and in the northern hemisphere. Grids are sized at one degree by one degree.

Purpose: These data are intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and to provide users with geographic data for cartography and other types of geographic analysis. Data can be used with geographic information systems (GIS) software to display and analyze information on geographic positions, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data.
